title: 英国预算案出炉 财政缓冲与增长预期成焦点
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This is a budget for the working people of Britain.
segments.zh: 这是一份为英国劳动人民制定的预算案。

segments.en: For British businesses, big and small, delivered at a time when global uncertainties and pressures are swirling worldwide and hitting people here at home.
segments.zh: 面向英国大大小小的企业，在全球不确定性交织、压力波及本国民众之际推出。

segments.en: A budget built on fiscal discipline which matches immediate action today with clear direction for the future.
segments.zh: 这份预算以财政纪律为基础，将当下的即时行动与未来的清晰方向相结合。

segments.en: First, by giving Britain some breathing space on the cost of living and the cost of business.
segments.zh: 第一，在生活成本和企业经营成本上给英国一些喘息空间。

segments.en: Second, by backing the enterprise of British business to unleash innovation and growth in every postcode
segments.zh: 第二，支持英国企业的进取精神，在每个地区释放创新与增长。

segments.en: and third, by tackling the big challenges on energy, on national security, on public service procurement
segments.zh: 第三，应对能源、国家安全、公共服务采购方面的重大挑战。

segments.en: In this budget, I will set out the new approach this administration is taking.
segments.zh: 在这份预算中，我将阐述本届政府采取的新方针。

segments.en: Led by the vision of our new Prime Minister, demonstrated in our first 100 days.
segments.zh: 以新首相的愿景为引领，在执政百日中展现。

segments.en: Demonstrated in our first 100 days, carried through today's budget the 10-year plan for Britain and the spending review next year.
segments.zh: 在执政百日中展现，贯穿今日预算、英国十年计划以及明年的支出审查。

segments.en: To steer us through the global economic storms today, to chart a new course for Britain in the years ahead, to give people fresh hope for Britain's future.
segments.zh: 引领我们应对当今全球市场波动，为英国未来数年规划新航向，让人民对英国的未来重燃希望。
